label: TP
reason: Two alerts are true positives: http-response-splitting (L69) and insecure-cookie (L69) both involve user input flowing unsafely into the cookie header. The XSS alert (L73-L75) is a false positive because ESAPI.encodeForHTML() properly encodes user input before HTML output.

evidence.note: Cookie value str derived from user input without CRLF validation enables response splitting
Cookie explicitly configured with setSecure(false) creating insecure cookie vulnerability
XSS alert is FP because ESAPI encoder sanitizes user input before HTML output
